summary: The Goshen Township Zoning Commission held a public hearing on zoning case ZC 2026-008, a request to rezone 1642 State Route 28 from B2 to PDB (Planned Development Business) to allow expansion of an existing self-storage facility. The applicant, Bill Kong of Ocean Storage, sought to add six one-story drive-up storage buildings totaling approximately 38,000 square feet. The commission recommended approval with conditions including modified setbacks, a reduced 10-foot perimeter buffer, and an 8-foot privacy fence around the entire business perimeter. The recommendation will go to the Board of Trustees for final legislative decision.
decisions: Approved video meeting minutes from September 1, 2026

Recommended approval of ZC 2026-008 zoning map amendment to rezone 1642 State Route 28 from B2 to PDB with conditions including: residential building setback aligned with the eastern portion of building one, reduced residential perimeter buffer to 10 feet from the fence line, and 8-foot privacy fence around the entire business perimeter (passed unanimously 5-0)

notes: No public comments were made either in support or opposition. The applicant clarified that the expansion would only occur within the existing fenced area and would not extend into the treed portion at the rear of the property. The commission lacked precise measurements from the applicant's site plan, which complicated setting exact setback distances, so they used the eastern wall of an existing building as a reference line. The property also includes a car wash and laundromat at the front.
